craftsmanship.title: Exceptional Craftsmanship
craftsmanship.subtitle: Each HolyFans piece is meticulously crafted with premium materials and artistic attention to detail, creating wearable art that lasts a lifetime.

story.paragraph1: Our journey begins with the finest materials sourced from trusted suppliers who share our commitment to excellence. Every thread, every print, and every detail is carefully selected to ensure your HolyFans piece not only looks beautiful but stands the test of time.
story.paragraph2: The artistic process behind our 'Nossa Senhora da Rosa' design combines traditional techniques with modern innovation. Our skilled artisans bring each piece to life through a meticulous process that honors both heritage and contemporary style.
story.paragraph3: From the initial sketch to the final quality check, every step in our creation process is infused with passion and precision. We believe that true luxury lies in the details, and it shows in every stitch, print, and finish.

objections.title: Common Questions & Concerns
objections.subtitle: We understand you may have questions about our products and process. Here are answers to the most common concerns we hear from our community.

trust_banner.title: Shop with Confidence
trust_banner.description: Your satisfaction is our top priority. We're here to ensure you have an exceptional experience from browsing to wearing.

objection1.question: Is the design too religious or obvious?
objection1.answer: Our 'Nossa Senhora da Rosa' design is created to be meaningful yet subtle. The artistic interpretation allows you to express your faith in a way that feels personal and comfortable, making it appropriate for various settings while still carrying deep significance.

objection2.question: What about the quality and durability?
objection2.answer: We use premium materials and advanced printing techniques to ensure your piece lasts. The combination of high-quality fabric, professional printing, and reinforced details means your HolyFans piece will maintain its beauty through regular wear and proper care.

objection3.question: Is it worth the investment?
objection3.answer: HolyFans pieces are more than clothing - they're wearable art with meaning. The combination of premium materials, artistic design, and spiritual significance creates value that extends far beyond the price. Plus, our quality guarantee ensures your investment is protected.

objection4.question: What if it doesn't fit or I don't like it?
objection4.answer: We offer a 30-day satisfaction guarantee. If your piece doesn't meet your expectations for any reason, we'll make it right. Our size M is designed to fit most people comfortably, and we're here to help you find the perfect fit.

objection5.question: How do I care for my HolyFans piece?
objection5.answer: Care is simple! Machine wash cold inside out, tumble dry low, and avoid ironing directly on the design. Following these simple care instructions will keep your piece looking beautiful for years.

general.title: General
general.description: Basic information about HolyFans and our mission

q1.question: What is HolyFans?
q1.answer: HolyFans is a Christian clothing brand that creates meaningful, stylish apparel featuring faith-inspired designs. We focus on creating pieces that allow you to express your faith elegantly and comfortably.

q2.question: Where are HolyFans products made?
q2.answer: Our products are crafted with care using premium materials from trusted suppliers. We work with skilled artisans who share our commitment to quality and attention to detail.

q3.question: Do you ship internationally?
q3.answer: Yes! We ship worldwide. Based in Portugal, we proudly serve customers across Europe and globally. Shipping times and rates vary by location.

product.title: Products
product.description: Details about our materials, designs, and quality

q1.question: What materials do you use?
q1.answer: We use premium cotton blends selected for comfort, durability, and print quality. Our materials are chosen to ensure your piece looks great and lasts long with proper care.

q2.question: How do the designs hold up over time?
q2.answer: Our designs are created using advanced printing techniques combined with embroidery and metal details. With proper care, your HolyFans piece will maintain its beauty for years.

q3.question: Are the designs suitable for everyday wear?
q3.answer: Absolutely! Our designs are created to be versatile and comfortable for daily wear while maintaining their artistic and spiritual significance.

shipping.title: Shipping & Returns
shipping.description: Information about delivery, returns, and exchanges

q1.question: How long does shipping take?
q1.answer: Shipping times vary by location: Portugal (2-3 business days), Europe (5-7 business days), International (10-15 business days). You'll receive tracking information once your order ships.

q2.question: What is your return policy?
q2.answer: We offer a 30-day satisfaction guarantee. If you're not completely satisfied with your purchase, you can return it for a full refund or exchange. Items must be unworn and in original condition.

q3.question: How do I track my order?
q3.answer: Once your order ships, you'll receive an email with tracking information. You can also track your order by logging into your account on our website.
